info.title: Supergood Solutions public API
info.summary: Public reads of the rate card and service list, and the fit-check POST.
info.description:
Two GET documents are static files on https://supergood.solutions. The fit check is POST https://supergood-intake.vercel.app/api/intake. No API key, bearer token, or account is required. See https://supergood.solutions/auth.md.

Version 1.0.0 is the current contract. pricing.json and services.json are the full list in one response and are not paged. A breaking change keeps the old path and adds a new one. This host cannot send a Sunset or Deprecation header (GitHub Pages). The developers page records the change: https://supergood.solutions/developers/.

The intake POST is not idempotent. A retry can email Ryan twice. There is no Idempotency-Key support and no published rate limit.

servers.description: Static reads served by GitHub Pages.

tags.name: intake
tags.description: Fit-check submission. Each accepted POST emails Ryan.

get.description: Returns the same offers as https://supergood.solutions/pricing/ in one JSON document. No query parameters. Not paged. Safe to call. No auth.
Returns the five public services in one JSON document. No query parameters. Not paged. Safe to call. No auth.

servers.description: Fit-check function. Separate project from this static site.

post.description: Emails the inquiry to Ryan Sandoval. Send one request per person. A repeat POST sends another email. No auth. Browser pages on https://supergood.solutions receive Access-Control-Allow-Origin for this URL. The form at /start/ will not submit until 3 seconds after the first field focus. On 2026-10-29 the function returned 200 for elapsedMs of 1, so do not treat elapsedMs as a server-side lock. Leave company as an empty string. Put the employer in companyName.

example.name: Ada Lovelace
example.handoff: A Monday report rebuilt by hand from three spreadsheets.

200.description: The inquiry was accepted. Ryan reads it and replies.

400.description: The body was rejected. error is required when name, email, or handoff is missing or not a string. Send all three as non-empty strings. error is email when the address is not a complete name@domain form. Fix the address and send once.

405.description: The method was not POST. Send POST with Content-Type application/json. A GET to this URL returns this error.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the numeric prices.

updated.description: Calendar date the document was last edited, YYYY-MM-DD.

price.description: Fixed price in currency. Present when the offer has a single price.

priceFrom.description: Lowest published price in currency. The quoted price can be higher.

email.description: Work email Ryan should reply to.

handoff.description: The manual work they want off the team's plate, in their words.

company.description: Honeypot. Send an empty string. The employer name goes in companyName.

enum: Running, but we don't trust it
currentState.description: Where the work sits today. Optional. Empty string if unknown.

teamSize.description: How many people touch the work. Optional.

timeline.description: When they want to move. Optional.

source.description: Where the request came from. The form sends supergood.solutions/start. The in-page tool sends supergood.solutions/webmcp.

elapsedMs.description: Milliseconds since the person started the form. The /start/ page refuses to send before 3000. The function accepted 1 on 2026-10-29.

FitCheckError.description: Observed error body. The code is the only machine-readable field. There is no separate message or hint property.

error.description: method: use POST. required: send name, email, and handoff as non-empty strings. email: send a complete email address.
